pull_request.title: Documentation: redraw sector views with the restored LAr prototype
pull_request.head: codex/restored-lar-sector-views
pull_request.body:
Redraw the Si–W sector and neighbouring half-sectors alongside the **restored 1.8 mm Pb LAr prototype** used for PR #148's restored 10k control. Both native DD4hep views have the same XY axes; the two close-ups now use the exact same physical coordinates and magnification.

The marked straight IP ray follows the retained Si–W structural seam (0 sensitive path segments), while crossing inclined active gaps in LAr (110 sensitive path segments). The LAr sampling radii are 1772.8–2350 mm and warm outer radius 2641.7 mm. Labels distinguish Si–W apothems from LAr circular radii. These are geometric path segments, not independent sampling layers or energy-response measurements.

![Updated native sector comparison](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/bd01e692e513215a301a2493a37736da9acee876/docs/design/figures/sector-gap-restored/siw-restored-lar-sector-gap.png?raw=true)

[SVG](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/restored-lar-sector-views/docs/design/figures/sector-gap-restored/siw-restored-lar-sector-gap.svg) · [PDF](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/restored-lar-sector-views/docs/design/figures/sector-gap-restored/siw-restored-lar-sector-gap.pdf) · [Recipe, hashes and limits](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/restored-lar-sector-views/docs/validation/sector-gap-restored/README.md)

Stacked on #147's drawing tools. Geometry input depends on #148: LAr declared model source `53797385c374118838b2ade1ec3362328683cf75`; every input geometry source for both models additionally checked against prototype revision `8f7a7c8bd86f4d9c67c11b37d91aea76790feee4`. Both Si–W native rasters reproduce the earlier published hashes exactly. Prior drawing and evidence remain preserved.

Validation: both exact validated compact/library pairs loaded and rendered under the reverified DD4hep/ROOT runtime; 4 portable provenance guards and the native analytic subpixel-film/chord fixture pass. PNG layout visually inspected; SVG/PNG/PDF plus compact source and runtime provenance retained. No new transport, geometry change or engineering/design acceptance. Independent PhysVal review of `bd01e692e513215a301a2493a37736da9acee876` found no material scientific or visual blocker. Project, software-inventory, session, interaction-retention and token checks pass locally, including the token preview build. Exact closed drawing-parent and separate review-turn usage, with selected visible evidence, are retained once; the current baseline/gap coordination turn remains active and excluded.

Tracking: TASK-PUB-ECAL-LAYOUT-REVIEW, DES-030/031/032. Dedicated paired session; completed drawing-parent counters are now recorded; current coordination counters remain active and excluded. Raw models, libraries and run logs remain local. Draft for human review.

Stack (2026-11-18): **#147 → #148 → #149 → #150 → #151**. #150 selects the restored LAr EM working baseline; #151 adds the separate conditional 400 mm-gap prototype. Merge bottom-up, retargeting the next PR to main after its base merges. Canonical session/interaction records retain exact closed-turn accounting once; engineering approval and the current active coordination turn remain separate.
